v006_line_syntax.rule: One pin per line, starting at column 0 (a fenced code block is fine), fields separated by single spaces, the absolute path last (it may contain spaces). The pinning entry id is the nearest preceding line that starts with "## A<digits>". Any line that starts with a pin keyword and does not match the form refuses.
forms: SPEC_PIN S0_<SEED|J0|J1|J2>_SERIAL <sha256> <absolute path>  (RI45-13; path = root's DRY fill)
WATCH_PIN MEMORY_WATCH <sha256> <absolute path>            (A135.5: the NGC-extended GiB watch)
v006_line_syntax.NAME: [A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_]*; a name appears once per kind in all of V006 (a duplicate refuses)
